registration_basis: Engineering hypotheses and independent mechanical fixtures; not selected against the 130 generator-reference labels or candidate outputs.
node_definition: One nonempty independent native text object using the union of its actual paragraph envelopes; native table cells, auxiliary text, unsupported rotation and unmeasured layouts are excluded with explicit counts or unresolved records.
distance_unit: Euclidean edge-to-edge distance in physical page points divided by the median line height of the pair. Actual measured line boxes are preferred; font size times 1.2 is an explicitly named typographic proxy when line boxes are unavailable.
edge_definition: Join two nodes if local line-height gap <=1.25, or their actual text-envelope intersection covers >=5% of the smaller envelope. Preserve native parent/group identity as descriptive evidence, without treating every ungrouped textbox as a separate semantic module.
region_definition: Evaluate every connected component and each closed two-hop graph neighbourhood; all required evidence is measured on the same node set and its bounding rectangle. Never combine independent maxima from different windows.
score_semantics: Ordered evidence strength, not defect probability; candidates require dense tight relations plus either actual-envelope overlap, irregular spatial organization, or cross-module interference. A normal aligned grid with sufficient gaps is protected; dense table cells and explicit flow-node labels are outside independent-text crowding scope.
